126371: First sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Despite the negligible age difference among them, she took the role of the eldest sister properly. She is also trusted enough to act as their confidant and leader. Ichika aspires to become an actress. She likes to tease Fuutarou.
126372: Second sister of the Nakano quintuplets. She usually acts as the mother of the family, she cooks for them and takes care of their medical needs. Among the five sisters, she is the one who has the highest hostility towards Fuutarou and often rebels against him.
126373: Third sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. She is a silent and reserved girl. Miku tends to have a pessimistic attitude and little confidence regarding herself. Due to Fuutarou's influence, she's the first among the sisters who open up to him.
126374: She is the fourth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets, and one of the main characters of the Quintessential Quintuplets series. Having a cheerful and energetic personality, she has a strong tendency of helping people out. Yotsuba is an active and easygoing girl.
126375: Fifth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Itsuki is a serious and earnest girl. Her speech is formal and polite. She is also someone who can't be honest with herself and having difficulty to be more straightforward.
128063: Fuutarou is the main protagonist of the 5-toubun no Hanayome series. He is a student of the Asahiyama High School. He lives with his father, Isanari Uesugi, and younger sister, Raiha Uesugi, in a small apartment.
130111: Fuutarou's cheerful younger sister. Being the only female and the most family-conscious she is effectively the head of the small household. Her cute facial expressions will often sway others' hearts.
135383: Stepfather of the Nakano Quintuplets after their mother remarried, several years before the series begins. He runs a large hospital and is also a doctor.
157106: She is a former student of Rena Nakano (the Nakano Quintuplets' mother) during her 2nd year of senior high school and she is currently a cram school lecturer. She is first seen encountering Itsuki Nakano while visiting the Nakano Family Grave.
157107: He is the maternal grandfather of the Nakano quintuplets and the father of Rena Nakano. He is the manager of the Toraiwa Hot Springs inn.
157111: He is the secretary of Maruo Nakano and occasionally driver of the Nakano quintuplets. Ebata is said to have a professional history as a school teacher. He cares deeply for the quintuplets.
157112: He is a student of Class 3-1. He is introduced as the antithesis of Fuutarou Uesugi in terms of appearance, personality and popularity. Yuusuke is envious of Fuutarou because he is always academically the best student in his grade, leaving Yuusuke a pitiful second place.
157114: She is a 3rd-year high school student and captain of the track team. Eba praises Yotsuba for her athletic talent, she urges for Yotsuba to join the track team by exploiting the latter's easy-going character, despite Yotsuba's failed plea of refusal.
157144: Student of the Asahiyama High School. Before the school camping trip, Maeda asked Ichika Nakano to see him in a class where he would ask her to dance with him at the bonfire dance.
157158: She is the captain of the Basketball Club. Yotsuba would constantly assist the the Club, Due to her inability to say no. Hongo would even ask her if she wanted to join the club, to which Yotsuba refuses.
157161: Oda is a film producer of the Oda Talent Productions and Ichika Nakano's manager. He is the single father of Kiku.
157189: The manager of the pastry shop Revival, His shop rivals the bakery shop Komugiya.
157192: The manager of the bakery shop Komugiya, Her shop rivals the pastry shop Revival.
157195: She is the biological mother of the Nakano Quintuplets who worked as a teacher. She was a teacher at a high school where she was well-loved and respected by her students. Shimoda was once her student.
157196: He is a guest instructor in the test prep class that Itsuki Nakano have attended.
157198: He is a boy who appeared in Fuutarou Uesugi's Kyoto trip flashback. Similar to Fuutarou, he was focused on studying, even doing maths during a field trip. He and Takebayashi were childhood friends.
157199: He is a football coach that appeared five years ago in the Nakano quintuplets' flashback. He seems to have known a lot about the quintuplets and usually asks them to help him with football practices. He had a crush on the quintuplets' mother, Rena Nakano.
214405: Tsubaki is a student of Asahiyama High School's Class 3-1. She is a member of the Broadcasting Club.
231825: A student at the Asahiyama High School. She danced with Maeda at the bonfire during the school field trip.
242709: She is a student of the Asahiyama High School and friend of Nino Nakano.
242710: He is a male student at the Asahiyama High School and a classmate of Nino Nakano during her second year.
242711: He teaches History. He was also the homeroom teacher of Yotsuba Nakano's sophomore class, class 2-2.
256743: A shopkeeper from the firework festival.
256748: Basketball club captain of the basketball club at Asahi High School.
